title: 第5章 上奏
content_zh:
第5章上奏
拼命咳嗽之后，张安世道：“嗯……不谈这个……我现在有心事。”
“心事，啥心事？”张軏见张安世对火药没有兴趣，禁不住心里有些失望，这可是自己好不容易从兄长的军营里偷来的。
张安世叹息道：“你们也知道，我很穷。所以我想若是有一笔银子，能去做一些小买卖就好了。”
“男子汉大丈夫做什么买卖。”朱勇一脸鄙夷。
他们这样出身的人，对于商业自然是没兴趣的。
张安世却不然。
他很清楚，距离姐夫登基，还有许多年呢。
张家虽然有姐夫接济，可毕竟用的是姐夫的钱。
张世安上辈子是穷怕了，想到自己在这世上没有一笔银子，就觉得不安。
“主要是我想到了一个好买卖，这等好事，也只有自家兄弟，我才肯说，要不……我们凑一点银子……”
“银子……”一听到这个，朱勇脸都变了。
他爹朱能，可吝啬的很，怎么肯拿银子放在他这等孩子身上？
于是他拨浪鼓似的摇头道：“俺爹不肯给的，俺若去问，他得打俺不可。”
张安世道：“你去问你娘。”
朱勇想了想，又摇头：“迟早俺爹也要知道的，到时…少不得还要挨骂，说俺是个败家玩意…”
这话说的……
看来问题的关键在于让大家放下心理包袱，年轻人嘛，毕竟思想还没滑坡。
于是张安世语重心长地道：“二弟啊……我来问问你，你们朱家将来是传给谁的……”
朱勇想也不想，便断然道：“当然是俺，家里就俺一个独苗，家业不传给俺，还能传给谁？“

张安世循循善诱道：“对呀，这家业迟早都是你的，对不对？那么我再问你，既然家业是你的，你花自己的银子咋了？我不是挑拨离间，可有些话不知当讲不当讲。”
朱勇认真道：“你讲。”
张安世叹息道：“朱家就是你家，朱家的银子都是你的，现在是谁成天在花朱家的银子。”
此言听罢，朱勇突然有一种醍醐灌顶的感觉，身躯一颤：“哎呀，大哥不提醒，俺竟没想明白。对呀，这家都是俺的，倒是俺那爹……成日乱花银子，前日还花了一百多两银子去买了一柄好马呢，这败家玩意，他这是在花俺的钱，败俺的家啊。”
张安世安慰他：“算了，谁家不会出一个败家爷们呢，你就想开一些，就当你爹不懂事吧。”
朱勇道：“现在想来……俺便有些咽不下这口气了，寻个时候，非要狠狠训斥他一通才好，张大哥说的对，俺自己的银子，倘若不花，岂不都便宜俺爹了？回头我去问俺娘，叫她拿银子来。”
张軏在一旁听得目瞪口呆，他觉得哪里不对，可细细一想，道理似乎就是这个道理。
三人正说着，突然有一个少年匆匆进入了课堂，惊呼道：“先生来了，先生来了……”
大家并不怕胡俨，可这少年一脸骇然的样子，却让人觉得奇怪，先生来就来了嘛，为何吓成这个样子？
却在此时，课堂外走进一个人来。
只是……不是胡俨。
而是一个穿着黑色袈裟的老和尚。
老和尚一出现，方才还神气十足的朱勇、张軏二人，瞬间垂下头去，竟好像犯错的孩子，大气不敢出。
其他的少年，也一个个像老鼠见了猫似的。
老和尚正是姚广孝。
姚广孝进来之后，笑容可掬的样子，他似乎对自己的形象很自信，是那种和善的长者。
不过少年们的神色却让姚广孝略有尴尬。
当然，这和尚想来早就不知尴尬该怎么写了。
于是，他释然落座，依旧用一种慈眉善目的模样道：“听闻你们每日用功在此读书，贫僧甚是欣慰。”
胡俨的脸抽了抽。

少年们却有一种山雨欲来的恐惧。
似乎他们从自己的父辈那里……听闻到了一些这和尚不太好的传闻，比如……杀人笑嘻嘻……或者每日苦口婆心的，就是劝大家造反之类。
姚广孝顾盼着众少年，依旧还是和蔼可亲，不断赞许的颔首：“不错，不错，都是好儿郎，我大明后继有人啊。”
见众人无动于衷。
姚广孝清了清嗓子，又道：“不过贫僧听胡公说，你们偶尔会嬉戏，是吗？不要怕，这也没什么打紧，少年人偶有过失也没有什么妨碍……”
胡俨急了：“姚公，不是偶有过失，是……”
姚广孝给他使了个眼色，胡俨这才住口。
姚广孝道：“今日贫僧来此，是来检验一下功课的，尔等都是功勋之后，将来少不得要做我大明栋梁，不妨……如此吧，你们拿起笔墨纸砚，索性就书写一封奏疏，将自己对朝廷的看法和得失写出来，贫僧不出题，你们大可随意，想写什么便写什么，权当是为朝廷建言献策。“
建言献策？
这一下子，真是将所有人都搞懵了。
张安世也有些狐疑，不知姚广孝葫芦里卖的什么药。
只是姚广孝话音落下，大家还是都乖乖地取了笔墨纸砚，一个个开始搔头摸耳起来。
明伦堂里很安静，落针可闻。
胡俨却是频频的皱眉，姚广孝这个人他了解，是很看不上那些死读书的腐儒的，所以考校学问，肯定不会让大家去默写四书五经，只是让一群乳臭未干的小子建言献策，这不是儿戏吗？
他趁机上前，和姚广孝窃窃私语，用极低的声音道：“姚公……朱勇、张軏这几个竖子不追究了？”
“急什么？”姚广孝气定神闲，低声回应。
胡俨道：“少年人不知天高地厚，倘若轻轻放过……只怕……”
姚广孝微笑，轻声回应着道：“名正方才言顺吧。”
“这是……”
“若只是因为顽皮就惩罚他们，这惩罚未免轻巧，只怕他们记不住。“

“可是……这与考校有什么关系？”
“考校不一样，他们下笔写了奏疏，这奏疏里就有文章可作了。”
胡俨还是有些不解：“什么文章？”
姚广孝轻描淡写地道：“当初陛下在北平时，欲清君侧，于是召集大军，誓师南下，只是那一日风雨大作，大风竟将王府的檐瓦吹落在地。风吹落瓦乃是不祥之兆，因此连陛下都不禁变色。可贫僧在那时却上前对陛下说：‘这是吉兆啊！自古飞龙在天，必有风雨相从。王府的青瓦堕地，这预示着殿下要用上皇帝的黄瓦了。’于是士气大振，陛下也是振奋不已！”
姚广孝顿了顿，继续别有深意地看了胡俨一眼：“你看……是非黑白的关键不在于它原本是什么样子，而是看你如何诠释。不教而诛为之虐也，少年们写奏疏，里头就有文章可作，总能从他们的文章之中摘出一些他们‘胆大包天’的证据来。如此一来，即算是证据确凿，名正言顺了。到时狠狠收拾一番，也就有了一个由头，总之……是非黑白，尽操持我手，待呈送陛下，雷霆雨露，自有分教！”
此言一出，胡俨居然没有丝毫的喜悦，而是下意识地打了个寒颤，他当然知道，姚广孝这只是敲打一下那些不知天高地厚的竖子。
可……为何自己却遍体生寒了呢？
姚广孝没有理会胡俨，继续怡然自得。
而少年们却是一个个绞尽脑汁，上奏……言事……
这对于绝大多数少年而言，颇有挑战。
张安世倒是沉思了许久，心里有了腹稿，这才小心翼翼地下笔。
时间过去了小半时辰后，姚广孝起身收了卷子。
却也没有看，而是依旧和蔼地道：“好了，真是辛苦了你们，这些奏疏，我自当呈送陛下。”
说罢，施施然地走了，胡俨则是亦步亦趋地跟着姚广孝，要亲自将他送出去。
这二人一走，少年们终于长长地松了口气，顿时这明伦堂里便叽叽喳喳起来。
朱勇凑到张安世的面前，低声道：“大哥，你奏疏里写了什么？”
张安世道：“我乱写的。”
他这一说，朱勇和张軏都面露出狂喜之色，朱勇笑嘻嘻道：“俺也是，俺也是，俺也是胡写的。”
张軏也高兴得手舞足蹈：“我交了白卷哩，实在想不出该写点啥，原本还有担心，现在咱们都是胡写，这便放心不少了。到时我们兄弟三人，有难同当！”
张安世：“啊……这……”

张安世用一种奇怪的眼神看张軏。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Preface
After coughing desperately, Zhang Anshi said: "Well... let's not talk about this... I have something on my mind now."
"What's on your mind?" Zhang Fu couldn't help but feel a little disappointed when he saw that Zhang Anshi was not interested in gunpowder. He had finally stolen it from his brother's military camp.
Zhang Anshi sighed and said, "As you know, I am very poor. So I thought it would be great if I had some money to do some small business."
"What kind of business does a man do?" Zhu Yong looked disdainful.
People of their background are naturally not interested in business.
Not so with Zhang Anshi.
He knew very well that it would still be many years before his brother-in-law ascended the throne.
Although the Zhang family is supported by a brother-in-law, it is his brother-in-law's money that is used after all.
Zhang Shian was afraid of poverty in his last life, and he felt uneasy when he thought that he didn't have a single fortune in this world.
"The main thing is that I thought of a good deal. Only my brothers would be willing to talk about such a good thing. How about... let's raise some money..."
"Yinzi..." Upon hearing this, Zhu Yong's face changed.
His father, Zhu Neng, was very stingy. How could he spend money on children like him?
So he shook his head like a rattle and said, "My father won't give it to me. If I ask, he will have to beat me."
Zhang Anshi said: "Go and ask your mother."
Zhu Yong thought for a while and shook his head: "Sooner or later, my father will also know. When the time comes... I will probably be scolded, saying that I am a waste of money..."
This is what I said...
It seems that the key to the problem is to let everyone put down their psychological baggage. Young people, after all, their thinking has not declined yet.
So Zhang Anshi said earnestly and sincerely: "Second brother... let me ask you who your Zhu family will pass on to in the future..."
Zhu Yong didn't even think about it and said decisively: "Of course it's me. I'm the only child in the family. If the family business is not passed down to me, who else can it be passed on to?"
Zhang Anshi said seductively: "Yes, sooner or later this family property will be yours, right? Then let me ask you again, since the family property is yours, why are you spending your own money? I am not sowing discord, but I don't know whether to say something or not."
Zhu Yong said seriously: "You tell me."
Zhang Anshi sighed: "The Zhu family is your family, and all the Zhu family's money belongs to you. Who is spending the Zhu family's money all day long now?"
After hearing these words, Zhu Yong suddenly felt enlightened and his body trembled: "Oh, brother, I didn't remind you, but I didn't think about it. Yes, this family belongs to me, but my father... spends money all day long, and he spent more than 100 taels of silver to buy a good horse the day before yesterday. This wasteful thing, he is spending my money and ruining my family."
Zhang Anshi comforted him: "Forget it, who wouldn't have a prodigal man? If you want to be more liberal, just think that your father is ignorant."
Zhu Yong said: "Now that I think about it... I can't swallow this breath. I have to find a time to reprimand him severely. Brother Zhang is right. If I don't spend my own money, won't it be an advantage to my father? I will ask my mother later and ask her to bring the money."
Zhang Fu was dumbfounded as he listened. He felt something was wrong, but when he thought about it carefully, it seemed that this was the truth.
While the three of them were talking, a young man suddenly entered the classroom in a hurry and exclaimed: "Sir is here, sir is here..."
No one was afraid of Hu Yan, but the horrified look on this young man's face made people feel strange. He came as soon as he came, why was he so scared?
But at this moment, a person walked in outside the classroom.
It's just...not Hu Yan.
It was an old monk wearing a black cassock.
As soon as the old monk appeared, Zhu Yong and Zhang Fu, who had been so arrogant just now, immediately lowered their heads, as if they were children who had made mistakes and did not dare to express their anger.
The other teenagers were also like a mouse meeting a cat.
The old monk is Yao Guangxiao.
After Yao Guangxiao came in, he smiled brightly. He seemed to be very concerned about his image.Confident, he is the kind of kind elder.
However, the expressions of the young people made Yao Guangxiao slightly embarrassed.
Of course, this monk didn't know how to write embarrassing words for a long time.
So, he sat down with relief, and still said with a kind-hearted look: "I am very pleased to hear that you study hard here every day."
Hu Yan's face twitched.
The young people have a fear that a storm is coming.
It seemed that they had heard some not-so-good rumors about this monk from their fathers, such as... killing people with a smile... or he was telling everyone to rebel every day.
Yao Guangxiao looked at the young men, but he was still amiable and nodded with approval: "Yes, yes, they are all good men. I have someone to succeed me in Ming Dynasty."
Seeing everyone indifferent.
Yao Guangxiao cleared his throat and said again: "But I heard from Mr. Hu that you guys play occasionally, right? Don't be afraid, it doesn't matter. There is no hindrance if a young man makes mistakes..."
Hu Yan was anxious: "Mr. Yao, it's not that I made an accident, it was..."
Yao Guangxiao winked at him, and Hu Yan stopped talking.
Yao Guangxiao said: "The poor monk is here today to test his skills. After you have made great achievements, you will be the pillars of the Ming Dynasty in the future. You might as well... Let's do this. You pick up the pen, ink, paper and inkstone, and simply write a memorial to express your views, gains and losses on the court. The poor monk does not propose a topic. You are free to write whatever you want. You have the right to make suggestions for the court."
Any advice?
This time, everyone was really confused.
Zhang Anshi was also a little suspicious, wondering what kind of medicine Yao Guangxiao was selling in his gourd.
But after Yao Guangxiao finished speaking, everyone still obediently took out pens, ink, paper and inkstones, and started scratching their heads and ears one by one.
It was very quiet in Minglun Hall, and you could hear a needle drop.
Hu Yan frowned frequently. He knew that Yao Guangxiao looked down on those rotten scholars who were obsessed with studying. Therefore, in the school knowledge test, they would definitely not let everyone write down the Four Books and Five Classics. They would just ask a group of young boys to give advice. Isn't this child's play?
He took the opportunity to step forward and whispered to Yao Guangxiao, saying in a very low voice: "Mr. Yao... Zhu Yong and Zhang Fu are not going to be held accountable?"
"What's the rush?" Yao Guangxiao calmly responded in a low voice.
Hu Yan said: "Young people don't know how high the sky is. If you let me go lightly...I'm afraid..."
Yao Guangxiao smiled and responded softly: "Only when the name is right can the word be right."
"This is..."
"If you punish them just for being naughty, the punishment would be too light. I'm afraid they won't remember it."
"But...what does this have to do with the school entrance examination?"
"The examination school is different. They wrote the memorial, and there are articles to write in the memorial."
Hu Yan was still a little confused: "What article?"
Yao Guangxiao said lightly: "When His Majesty was in Peking, he wanted to clear the emperor's side, so he summoned an army and swore to march south. However, it was a stormy day, and the strong wind blew down the eaves and tiles of the palace. It was an ominous sign that the tiles were blown down by the wind, so even Your Majesty couldn't help but But the poor monk stepped forward and said to His Majesty: 'This is a good sign! Since ancient times, when the flying dragon is in the sky, there must be wind and rain. The green tiles of the palace fall to the ground, which means that His Majesty is going to use the emperor's yellow tiles.' So the morale of your Majesty was greatly boosted."
Yao Guangxiao paused and continued to look at Hu Yan with deep meaning: "Look...the key to right and wrong is not what it looks like originally, but how you interpret it. It is also cruel to punish someone without teaching. When young people write memorials, there are articles in them, and they can always learn from them. Some of the evidence of their "daringness" was extracted from their articles. In this way, the evidence is conclusive and justified. When the time comes to deal with it, there will be a reason. In short... the right and wrong are in my hands and will be presented to Your Majesty, Lei.Tingyulu has its own branch of teaching! "
As soon as these words came out, Hu Yan didn't feel the slightest joy, but shuddered subconsciously. Of course he knew that Yao Guangxiao was just knocking on the back of those ignorant people.
But... why am I feeling cold all over?
Yao Guangxiao ignored Hu Yan and continued to be content.
However, the young people were racking their brains one by one, writing... words and deeds...
This is quite a challenge for most teenagers.
Zhang Anshi pondered for a long time and had a draft in his mind before he started writing carefully.
After half an hour passed, Yao Guangxiao stood up and collected the papers.
But he didn't read it, but still said kindly: "Okay, thank you for your hard work. I will present these memorials to His Majesty. "
After that, Shi Shiran walked away, and Hu Yan followed Yao Guangxiao step by step, wanting to send him out personally.
As soon as these two people left, the teenagers finally breathed a long sigh of relief, and the Minglun Hall suddenly started to chatter.
Zhu Yong came up to Zhang Anshi and whispered: "Brother, what did you write in your memorial? "
Zhang Anshi said: "I wrote it randomly. "
When he said this, both Zhu Yong and Zhang Fu showed expressions of ecstasy, and Zhu Yong said with a smile: "Me too, me too, I also wrote nonsense. "
Zhang Fu also danced with joy: "I handed in the blank paper, and I really couldn't think of what to write. I was worried at first, but now we are all writing nonsense, so I feel relieved. When the time comes, the three of us brothers will share the same responsibility! "
Zhang Anshi: "Ah...this..."
Zhang Anshi looked at Zhang Fu with a strange look.
